newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam cargo hub is "quantum leap" -SIA.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam cargo hub is "quantum leap" -SIA.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) said on Saturday its US$15 million joint-venture air freight terminal at Vietnam's Tan Son Nhat Airport was "a quantum leap forward" for Ho Chi Minh City's airport.
SIA said in a statement the terminal's 100,000 tonnes per year capacity was "a quantum leap for Tan Soh Nhat Airport's total cargo handling capacity".
SIA said cargo volume on flights between Singapore and Ho Chi Minh City was growing at 59 percent annually and expected it to be close to 6,000 tonnes in the year to March 31.
The terminal was opened officially on Saturday. It has been operational since December 1996.

The terminal, owned 30 percent by SIA through its Singapore Airport Terminal Services unit, 55 percent by Vietnam Airlines and 15 percent by Southern Airports Services Company, is the second SIA joint venture in Vietnam.
It already has a partnership with Vietnam Airlines and Servair to build a flight kitchen at Hanoi's Noi Bai Airport where construction should start soon, the statement said.
